title: Dua for ease in affairs
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
translation: "O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty, if You wish, easy." (Ibn Hibban)
romanUrdu: "Aye Allah! Koi cheez aasan nahi magar jise Tu aasan bana de, aur Tu hi mushkil ko jab chahe aasan farma deta hai."
reflection: Recite this Prophetic supplication whenever a task or life test feels overwhelming.

title: Dua for anxiety & sorrow
shortDesc: Calm a restless heart with reliance on Allah.
translation: "Sufficient for us is Allah, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs." (Quran 3:173)
romanUrdu: "Hamare liye Allah hi kaafi hai aur Woh behtareen kaarsaaz hai."
reflection: Spoken by Prophet Ibrahim (AS) and Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in moments of deep trial.

title: Durood Shareef (6x)
shortDesc: Send abundant blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ.
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
translation: "O Allah, send Your grace, honour and mercy upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad."
romanUrdu: "Aye Allah! Rehmat aur barakat naazil farma Muhammad ﷺ par aur Aap ﷺ ki Aal par."
reflection: Sending blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ brings peace of heart and closeness on the Day of Judgment.
